sources.title: Cyberpunk 2077 live-action film in development at Paramount Pictures [Update]
sources.text: Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action film set in CD Projekt RED ‘s Cyberpunk 2077 universe, according to a Deadline report . G.I. Joe and Transformers film series producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura will produce the movie alongside CD Projekt RED. The film will be set in the Cyberpunk 2077 universe, though specific story details have not been announced. Update 4:00 p.m.: In a tweet , CD Projekt RED co-CEO Michal Nowakowski added, “We’re excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time.”

sources.title: Live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film reportedly in development, with CD Projekt Red collaborating with Paramount to make it
sources.text: UPDATE 12PM BST: CD Projekt Red seems to have confirmed the partnership and film, with joint-CEO Michał Nowakowski commenting on X that: "We're excited about Paramount as a future partner who shares our creative ambitions for the Cyberpunk franchise. We look forward to sharing more details at the appropriate time." ORIGINAL STORY 11:40AM BST: A live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film is reportedly in the works at Paramount Pictures. Producer Lorenzo di Bonaventura - a former Warner Bros. exec influential in signing the The Matrix and Harry Potter films, and known for producing the Transformers films - is said to be attached to the project, with CD Projekt Red collaborating. The report comes from Deadline , though the publication had no further information to share than what's above. CD Projekt Red told us it doens't have anything to share beyond what Nowakowski said on X. Believing that CD Projekt Red would venture into live-action film territory doesn't take a stretch of the imagination. The company's Netflix anime partnership on Cyberpunk Edgerunners has been a success, with a second series due to air this month, on 20th October . The first season, released in 2022, was "fantastic", Wes wrote in his Cyberpunk Edgerunners impressions article , and amassed considerable Netflix viewing figures . Live-action adaptations of video game-based series are also becoming increasingly popular, with The Last of Us and Fallout particularly finding wide success. CD Projekt Red being involved with the Cyberpunk 2077 adaptation would also somewhat heal a wound left by not being involved with The Witcher Netflix adaptation. CD Projekt art director Pawel Mileniczuk called this a "missed opportunity" when I talked to him for a Witcher 3 10-year anniversary article last year. Meanwhile, CD Projekt Red is working on Cyberpunk 2 , a project that's in pre-production, but with an expanding team - close to 200 people as of 31st July 2026 - full production doesn't seem far away. The sequel apparently adds a second city alongside the iconic Night City setting, and it's described as being like "Chicago gone wrong". Should the live-action film prove real, and be made, the questions are what story will it tell - the same as in Cyberpunk 2077? - and which actors will play the game's well-known roles? The most famous of those roles is Keanu Reeves' portrayal of Johnny Silverhand, a character who used Reeves' likeness in the game. Could Reeves star in a film adaptation? Cyberpunk 2077 was released in 2021 , and its rocky launch has since become infamous. But CD Projekt Red did extensive work improving the game after release, focusing its efforts around a kind of 2.0 relaunch alongside the game's "remarkable" Phantom Liberty expansion , in 2023. Paramount, meanwhile, recently acquired Warner Bros., and has since reorganised into mega-company Skydance. Activision's former leader Bobby Kotick has been employed on the board of it .

sources.title: GTA 6 Fan Says Rockstar Sent Them a Poster Just Because They Asked Nicely
sources.text: A Grand Theft Auto 6 fan in Brazil said they politely asked the Rockstar Games team to send them a poster – and it looks like they actually followed through. Reddit user aogustoo shared their story in a post late last month. What began as a "shot-in-the-dark email" they sent to Rockstar asking for a signed GTA 6 poster has turned into what seems to be a heartwarming moment for them and the community. "A while ago I took a complete shot in the dark and emailed Rockstar," they said. "I shared how hyped I was for GTA VI and asked if there was any chance I could get a poster for my room. "Honestly, I expected an automated reply or nothing at all. To my absolute surprise, an executive actually answered and shipped an official GTA VI poster straight from their New York office to my home in Brazil." You can see images, which show not only the poster but the emails they supposedly sent to receive it, above. As Rockstar (and the rest of the world) count down the days to GTA 6's November 19 launch, fans will no doubt be on the lookout for official merchandise like this. As many have pointed out, it's unclear if Rockstar truly took the time to send the poster, but the community is still looking to the moment as something worth celebrating as the countdown continues. "This is a massive W tho," Rockstar content creator @videotech said on X/Twitter . "This guy isn’t an influencer or someone famous, literally just a random Rockstar fan. Very kind of Rockstar and Take-Two to take the time and effort to do this." "​I blurred out all personal addresses, names, and contact emails to respect their privacy," aogustoo added. "Please don't flood their inbox with requests, as I'm pretty sure this was just a rare act of kindness from someone on their team." There's still so much about GTA 6 that we don’t know, but one thing is for sure: Rockstar will probably get even more emails after this. While we wait to learn more about the next Grand Theft Auto game ahead of its November 19 launch for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, you can check out IGN's recent interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson . You can also read about what Nintendo had to say about the chances of seeing GTA 6 on Switch 2 , some recently revealed radio stations , and even a batch of new screenshots . sources.name: Xbox Wire
sources.title: DMZ — 5 Features to Get Excited for in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s New Mode
sources.text: Call of Duty’s upcoming DMZ mode sounds like it’s shaping up to be something special. Set on the new Hajin map and inspired by the events and locations from Modern Warfare 4 ’s Campaign, this open-world combat environment will challenge you to loot, complete objectives, fight both enemies and rival Operators, and extract before everything you’ve earned is lost. Recent intel drops on the official Call of Duty Blog have given us a much clearer picture of what awaits in Hajin when DMZ launches as part of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 can gain Early Access to the game’s Campaign starting Friday, October 16 and all of DMZ starting Tuesday, October 20. The events within DMZ are set after the main MW4 Campaign, leaving a power vacuum in its wake. Now it’s up to you to identify a new, mysterious threat and dismantle its operations across the DMZ through various deployments. From scavenging for crafting materials and experimenting with new technology, to leveling up an Operator, the mode sounds like it offers plenty to look forward to. Here are five features to get excited for when you begin your deployment. The 3D Printer will be available back at the Forward Operating Base (FOB) between deployments and will serve as your primary crafting station to build equipment and upgrades for your loadout before you drop into Hajin. The Call of Duty Blog shares that , as you progress through the DMZ, you’ll unlock new crafting recipes to create more powerful equipment – as well as upgrades to the 3D Printer and even the Forward Operating Base itself. Recipes can also be found on deployments and, presuming you extract in one piece, you can then craft those items for your Operator back at the FOB. When focused on crafting new equipment, the two key things you’ll be looking for when looting on deployments will be Resources and 3D Printer Ingredients – these are the two types of main elements to craft all items. There are four basic Resources to find during a deployment: Synthetics, Electronics, Chemicals, and Metals, automatically broken down from looted items, into your Backpack and Stash. 3D Printer Ingredients are rarer materials found in specific areas of Hajin and are valuable as an ingredient to make a new Item. Examples include Binding Catalyst, Biomaterials, Detonators, and Control Units, to name a few. Once you have enough of these two types of materials, you can select how many copies of an item you want to craft at once, then choose where crafted items go: send completed items directly to your Stash for later or equip them directly to your Operator to quickly prepare for the next deployment. Having this flexibility in how you want to engage the enemy during your deployment can open a variety of experiences in DMZ and can make each deployment feel like it matters, even if you come back to the FOB with zero kills to your name – at least you’ve got handful of electronics or a comms module to make it worth your time. Extraction shooters are always more engaging when every deployment has a clear purpose. That’s not going to be problem with DMZ as it will offer three ways to deploy: Story Missions, Dynamic Operations, and Free Roam. Of those, Story Missions and Dynamic Operations are two that really stand out with their defined objectives and high-tier rewards. According to the Call of Duty Blog , Story Missions will feature narrative-led deployments that you can complete and replay, though some remain locked until prerequisites are met. Each entry provides briefing intel, required objectives, and rewards – usually high-value gear and DMZ Cash – along with options for a random mission and additional milestone rewards. Dynamic Operations, meanwhile, give squads multiple goals to pursue within the DMZ. After deploying, you choose an operation and complete its objectives to earn DMZ XP, Cash, and the ability to call in a Supply Drop filled with unpredictable loot. That extra payoff adds anticipation to every successful Op while making Dynamic Operations a promising source of both Cash and XP. Persistent Operators may be DMZ’s most exciting feature because they allow Hajin to leave a lasting mark on you. You’ll begin with two Operator slots, and unlock a third as you progress through DMZ levels. Each Operator then grows stronger by surviving deployments and earning DMZ XP. Each successful exfil levels up your Operator’s Dog Tags, and this is the key to gaining Trait Points for your Operator. You can invest those points across the Warfighter, Scout, and Survivalist Trait Trees, creating a meaningful choice between specialization and flexibility: with a maximum of 18 points to earn, and a choice of over 60 Trait Points to augment your Operator, you can tailor each Operator to your skills and preferred role. For example, Warfighter Traits include Combat Resistance, Quick Fix, and Viper Sense; Scout Traits include improved Thermal Padding, UAV Upgrade, and Field Crafting; while Survivalist Traits include Faster and Free Revives, increased Consumable Duration, and many more. But here’s where it gets dicey: if an Operator fails to extract and becomes MIA, you must either recover them with DMZ Cash or dismiss them. Because recovery costs rise with Trait investment, bringing back a high-level Operator becomes increasingly expensive. Recovered Operators keep their Traits but lose their gear, putting real weight behind every deployment. The chase for loot is at the heart of every extraction shooter, and DMZ makes each haul matter beyond the current deployment. Returning to base with a pack full of supplies doesn’t just feel rewarding – it improves your chances of success the next time you enter Hajin. Once you drop into a deployment, looting should be a top priority. Searching containers provides resources for combat, supports marked Operations, strengthens your position in Hajin, and offers a reliable way to earn DMZ XP and adva

sources.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Launch Rollout Adds DMZ Early Access
sources.text: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has added DMZ to its list of early access experiences available for pre-order players ahead of its launch later this month. Activision and Infinity Ward revealed a host of new details for its DMZ revamp in a blog post shared today. Early access for the mode joins campaign early access , with both available to those who pre-ordered either the standard or Vault Edition versions of the game across PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and/or Xbox Series X/S. Here's the full breakdown: Eligible players will gain early access to the Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign starting Friday, October 16. DMZ early access will then follow Tuesday, October 20, with the full launch unleashing the rest of the experience come Friday, October 23. All of the new details arrived with a new gameplay trailer for DMZ, which you can see below. DMZ was first introduced as Call of Duty's take on the extraction shooter experience with 2022's Modern Warfare 2 . It was expanded upon in the months that followed but was ultimately deemed to be an underwhelming prototype by many. Support ended in late 2023, and now, Activision is taking another swing at it. The DMZ in Modern Warfare 4 has been propped up as a fully fleshed-out evolution for the game mode. In today's post, Infinity Ward described the new take on the mode as the series' "definitive extraction shooter experience," promising persistent progression in the open-world combat environment known as the Hajin Exclusion Zone. "There's an interesting story with the DMZ beta, where we had to make some decisions," studio multiplayer creative director Joe Cecot said in a recent behind-the-scenes video (below). "Certain things we wanted to do, we couldn't do. At the end of the day, we learned a lot: That we made a very approachable, fun sandbox that was fun to fight in, to explore, to make friends in, to get into fights in. There's a bunch of stuff we left on the table, so as soon as we finished with the last game, we were just gung-ho on, 'OK, we know what we want to do.'" Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23 for PC and consoles. Our first proper look at DMZ gameplay arrived in June, with even more details shared earlier this week. While early access players will get to dive into DMZ and the story mode a few days earlier than others, core multiplayer offerings won't officially launch until that firm release date hits. You can see how the team at Infinity Ward is working to deal with wall-hack cheaters here . Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. stories.summary: And even GTA 6 might not be able to save it

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: US console market hasn't been this bad "since the early 80s," analyst says
sources.text: And even GTA 6 might not be able to save it It is absolutely no surprise to anyone in the market for a new gaming console that prices have risen rather sharply in the last year-and-change, but fresh insights from a trusted industry analyst put some context into just how bad things have gotten. The ongoing RAM shortages, coupled with tariff-driven increases in hardware prices, have driven each of the three big console manufacturers; Sony , Microsoft , and Nintendo; to drive up console prices numerous times in less than two years. If you want a brand-new PS5 Pro, you're looking at $900, while the disc version of the Xbox Series X is now priced at $800. Meanwhile, Nintendo's second Switch 2 price hike means you'll need to drop $500 on the base model of the current-gen system. Circana's Mat Piscatella, citing data from the company's US retail tracking system, says these price increases have, unsurprisingly, resulted in slowed sales for both Sony and Microsoft. Specifically, "For 2026 YTD ending August, Xbox hardware unit sales are down 33% versus a year ago in the US, while PlayStation hardware units are 25% lower," says Piscatella on Bluesky. "Xbox YTD US hardware unit sales are at an all-time low, while PlayStation is at lowest point since 2013." Looking at year-to-date console price changes in averages and percentages, Piscatella says "the average price a consumer has paid for a new Xbox console in 2026 YTD ending August is $529, 26% higher than a year ago, while the average PlayStation console has sold for $597, 20% higher than last year. "Both prices are at all-time US highs. Price sensitivity is becoming a real problem." Perhaps the release of the Big Video Game in November will help ease at least some of these declines. But this will also depend on product availability given the RAM and component crisis. And pricing, of course. The US hardware market has not been in a more precarious position since the early 80s. "Price sensitivity is becoming a real problem" just might be the most broadly relatable sentence possible living in the US in 2026, but Piscatella shares a small glimmer of hope in a certain video game that rhymes with Grand Theft Auto Fix. "Perhaps the release of the Big Video Game in November will help ease at least some of these declines," Piscatella says, clearly alluding to GTA 6 , but even that is a big uncertainty. "This will also depend on product availability given the RAM and component crisis. And pricing, of course," says Piscatella, concluding with a dramatic contextualization of the current environment: "The US hardware market has not been in a more precarious position since the early 80s." Hardware nerds unite, sign up to our free tech newsletter for a weekly digest of the hottest new tech, the latest gadgets on the test bench, and much more from the team at GamesRadar+. Of course, Piscatella seems to be referencing the historic video game crash that happened from 1983 to 1985 and saw revenue attributed to US home video game sales fall 97% from about $3.2 billion in 1983 to $100 million in 1985. We haven't quite reached that level of catastrophe yet, and there's hope component shortages and tariff-related costs will eventually stabilize and ease some of the pressure on the console market, but going into the holiday season, console shoppers shouldn't expect substantial relief outside of big sales like Black Friday. "Supply has been consistently available" - Acer's CEO says it's "impossible" for the memory shortage to last until 2030, but that average PC prices will still increase by 5-20% by the end of 2026 After earning an English degree from ASU, I worked as a corporate copy editor while freelancing for places like SFX Magazine, Screen Rant, Game Revolution, and MMORPG on the side. I got my big break here in 2019 with a freelance news gig, and I was hired on as GamesRadar's west coast Staff Writer in 2021. That means I'm responsible for managing the site's western regional executive branch, AKA my home office, and writing about whatever horror game I'm too afraid to finish. sources.title: As Xbox and PlayStation sales reach new lows, analyst says the "US hardware market has not been in a more precarious position since the early 80s"
sources.text: "Price sensitivity is becoming a real problem." PS5 and Xbox Series X/S consoles are more expensive than ever in most markets, thanks largely to memory components being gobbled up by AI data centres. Now, analyst Mat Piscatella worries the console market, at least in the US, hasn't looked this dire since the early 1980s, which was maybe not-so-coincidentally when the industry absolutely collapsed. Circana's Piscatella recently jumped online to reveal that Xbox and PS5 price hikes caused a big blow to sales, somewhat unsurprisingly. Xbox hardware sales are reportedly down 33% "versus a year ago in the US, while PlayStation hardware units are 25% lower." Those year-to-date stats mark a new all-time low for Xbox, and PlayStation's lowest point since 2013. "The average price a consumer has paid for a new Xbox console in 2026 YTD ending August is $529, 26% higher than a year ago, while the average PlayStation console has sold for $597, 20% higher than last year," Piscatella added. "Both prices are at all-time US highs. Price sensitivity is becoming a real problem." There's been some hope the incoming and meteoric launch of GTA 6 next month could give both consoles a boost, and Piscatella also noted that Rockstar's mammoth might "help ease at least some of these declines," but that's all dependent on pricing and "product availability." If all the RAM is booked for AI data centres, Microsoft and Sony won't be able to make as many consoles as they can sell. "The US hardware market has not been in a more precarious position since the early 80s," Piscatella added. Consoles aren't the only devices suffering from RAMaggedon, though. Almost every consumer electronic device has been subject to price increases the past few years. The PS5 , Switch 2 and Xbox Series X/S price tags have all been bumped up, sometimes multiple times, as well. Micron's CEO recently warned that memory shortages are set to persist until at least 2028. Xbox boss Asha Sharma also delivered a similar note months earlier: "When I joined as CEO in February, the price we paid for console storage components was over 2x as high as we paid last fall. These costs have since doubled again. And as we plan for the 2027 holiday season, we expect another significant increase, taking us over 5x the prices we paid only two years earlier."

sources.title: Will GTA 6 Ever Come To Switch 2? Nintendo Of America President Says Go Ask Rockstar
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 Switch 2 Grand Theft Auto 6 is the most anticipated gaming release ever and it won’t be on Switch 2, at least not at launch and possibly not ever. Asked about the possibility of an eventual port, Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard suggested it wasn’t up to her. âThatâs going to be a conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,â Pritchard told Variety in a new interview. In addition to being the only modern gaming console not getting GTA 6 this fall, Switch 2 is also the only console getting a first-party exclusive that’s going head-to-head with Rockstar’s open-world juggernaut. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake will arrive just two weeks ahead of time on November 5. But even if it remains a mystery whether the Switch 2 is capable of satisfactorily running GTA 6 , there are other games Rockstar could be porting to Nintendo’s newest device. Red Dead Redemption 2 still isn’t available on the handheld hybrid, despite coming to the last-gen PlayStation 4 and Xbox Series X/S. GTA 5 hasn’t been ported either. Virtuous, which ported Rockstar’s L.A. Noire to Switch, would love to take on the challenge. â[The] team is eager to adapt Grand Theft Auto 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 for the Nintendo Switch,â technical director Fong told Pocket Tactics . âWeâre personally big fans and believe these games can shine again on the Switch, delighting even more players.â Those open-world games are two of the only four games, out of the ten top-selling games of all time, that aren’t available on Switch 2. The others are PUBG and Wii Sports . A successor to the latter, Nintendo Switch Sports Resort , arrives on October 22. Bolstering the case for Rockstar getting GTA 5 on Switch 2, especially if GTA 6 i s a no-go, is the fact that GTA Online remains massively popular and Rockstar has yet to reveal plans for sunsetting it anytime soon. For Switch 2 fans who are pining for some some Vice City madness this November, well, there’s always G rand Theft Auto: The Trilogy â The Definitive Edition . That one is on Nintendo’s console. sources.title: GTA 6 On Switch 2 ‘Up To Take-Two’
sources.text: GTA 6 remains unconfirmed for Nintendo Switch 2 after Devon Pritchard says she has nothing to announce and points to Take-Two and Rockstar. Grand Theft Auto 6 is the most anticipated game of its generation. At launch, it will be available on the Sony PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S. A PC port is expected soon. As for Nintendo and its Switch 2 , a high-ranking Nintendo executive said the creators still have the final say on bringing GTA 6 to that platform. In an interview with Variety , Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard addresses GTA 6 on Switch 2 but makes no announcement, pointing to Take-Two and Rockstar. “That’s going to be a conversation for Take-Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time,” Pritchard says. She also noted that the Nintendo brand has always been for all ages, and they are continuing to do their best to provide a diverse experience for all players on their latest hardware. “We’re just at the beginning of seeing what Nintendo Switch 2 can do,” she said. The GTA franchise has had a spotty history on Nintendo hardware. Grand Theft Auto games have appeared on Nintendo platforms five times. The first two Grand Theft Auto games received Game Boy Color ports. Grand Theft Auto: Advance was an exclusive Nintendo Game Boy Advance release in 2004. Grand Theft Auto: Chinatown Wars was an original Nintendo DS game released in 2009. After a 13-year layoff, Grand Theft Auto: The Trilogy – The Definitive Edition arrived on the original Nintendo Switch in 2022. It collected games from the PlayStation 2 era. The trilogy included Grand Theft Auto 3 , Grand Theft Auto: Vice City , and Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas , all remastered and playable on the Nintendo Switch. Do you want to see GTA 6 on Switch 2? Sound off about this story and all others in our official Discord server. For more Insider Gaming coverage, check out everything announced during our recent 28 Games Later showcase . Also, don’t forget to sign up for our weekly newsletter . I'm Robert DeFelice. I spent years covering pro-wrestling industry for outlets such as Fightful. After years in wrestling journalism, I’ve transitioned to video games, another passion of mine.

sources.text: Nintendo of America boss defers GTA 6 questions to Rockstar and Take-Two Nintendo of America president Devon Pritchard said she has ânothing to announceâ when asked about the possibility of Grand Theft Auto 6 coming to Switch 2. So far, thereâs been no suggestion from either Nintendo or Rockstar that a port of GTA 6 could be considered for Switch 2 â or even technically feasible. However, some insiders have claimed that exploratory conversations have taken place behind the scenes. Officially, Nintendo is still keeping quiet, as when asked about the possibility of GTA 6 coming to Switch 2, Pritchard told Variety in a recent interview: âThatâs going to be a conversation for Take Two and Rockstar, but nothing to announce on my end at this time.â One former Rockstar open-world designer recently expressed doubt about the feasibility of GTA 6 coming to Nintendoâs platform. JÃ©rÃ©my Hartvick told the Kiwi Talkz podcast : “I don’t believe it even makes sense, because I’m not sure the audience for GTA 6 is the audience for Switch . If you’re a GTA fan, you would probably buy a console on which GTA will come out.â He added: “Does it make sense for you to go out of your way to probably deliver a subpar experience, because it does not run exactly the same when you know anyone will buy a PS5 to get your game?â Nintendo has seen a roster of mature-rated games released for Switch 2, including Cyberpunk 2077 , Resident Evil Requiem, and Elden Ring , partly facilitated by the systemâs increased power over its predecessor. The much-anticipated open-world sequel also suffered yet another significant gameplay leak, after the group âCyberleekâ posted a 25-minute video showing a variety of footage from GTA 6, much of which consists of heavy nudity.

sources.title: The Escapists 3 announced for PS5, Xbox Series, Switch 2, and PC
sources.text: Team17 has announced prison escape simulation game sequel The Escapists 3 for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , Switch 2 , and PC ( Steam ). It will launch in 2027. Here is an overview of the game, via its Steam page : Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3 . Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call. Learn the routine and watch the guards, take jobs and earn cash, swipe whatever isn’t nailed down and turn everyday junk into the beginnings of an escape plan. The Escapists 3 is a prison escape sandbox where you can dig, sneak, climb, fight, disguise yourself and improvise your way to freedom. Alone or with friends. Every prison is a system waiting to be understood, exploited and very badly outsmarted. Study the schedule, find the weak points and work out your own route to freedom. Dig beneath the walls, climb your way out or find another route entirely. And getting beyond the perimeter might only be the beginning. There’s no single solution, just good plans, bad plans and the occasional plan involving molten chocolate. Search cells, trade with inmates and complete jobs to get your hands on supplies. Over 120 items and weapons to loot and craft, almost anything can become part of an escape plan. Whether it should… that’s another question. Break out of five distinctive prisons, each with its own routines, characters, secrets and once you have snuck past the guards discover what waits for you beyond the walls. Lose yourself in dense forests, climb across gusty canyons, explore ancient catacombs and find your way across dangerous waters. Learn how each one works. Find the cracks in the system. Then convince yourself you’ve finally come up with the perfect way out. Earn XP as you play, unlock new skills and tailor your inmate to the way you want to escape. Develop different strengths, unlock new gameplay options and take what you’ve learned from one prison into the next. While you’re at it, why not go full Stockholm Syndrome and customise your cell? Try and escape solo or team up with friends. Play with two players in local split-screen, or take your escape online with up to four. Divide the jobs, play to each other’s strengths, coordinate the timing and execute the perfect prison break… and discover which of your friends is useless with a shovel. Watch the announcement trailer below. View the first screenshots at the gallery .

sources.name: Gematsu
sources.title: The Road of Dust and Sorrow launches December 3
sources.text: Cozy survival horror adventure game The Road of Dust and Sorrow will launch for PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series , Switch 2 , Switch , and PC via Steam on December 3, publisher Silver Lining Interactive and developed Painted Black Games announced. Here is an overview of the game, via Silver Lining Interactive: Dive into a story-driven survival horror adventure inspired by classics like Resident Evil and Silent Hill . A cure designed to end famine became humanity’s ruin. The failed experiment twisted people into feral creatures called Dusters, driven by primal hunger. Katherine and her daughter Ava roam the remnants of civilization, searching for a safer future. Their journey draws the attention of a Preacher and his mysterious cult, driven by an ancient hunger, they see humans as fertile soil. Streets lie abandoned, buildings rot from the inside out, and vegetation is growing back at an accelerated rate. Traces of the past linger, in homes—barricaded for protection, offices with supplies scattered, and stores picked clean of supplies. Humanity is shaped by desperation, how far will you go to survive? Claw your way through decaying streets, bloodthirsty monsters, locked rooms, and forgotten corridors. Solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, and survive encounters with feral Dusters for a chance to reach safety. Proceed with caution every door can lead to salvation… or devastation. Protect Ava at all cost. The world can die but she must live. Every step draws you deeper into a place that wants you gone. No one will save you, but you can fight. You can run. You can try to get her to safety.

sources.title: Phantom Blade Zero’s Fast-Paced Action Took 15 Years, Two RPG-Maker Games, And A Whole Lot Of Money To Bring To Life
sources.text: Action-RPG Phantom Blade Zero S-GAME Studio Iâve been tracking the release of Phantom Blade Zero for several years now, playing the game multiple times over the course of three years, from demos that felt like little more than vertical slices all the way to a multi-hour hands-on at Gamescom this year. For a time, it felt like the game had come out of nowhere; Iâd never encountered Chinese developer S-Gameâs previous titles, and assumed they were never released outside of the country. However, it turns out I simply wasnât paying attention, and Phantom Blade Zero is part of a franchise known as Rainblood thatâs over 15 years old and features a longtime series protagonist who has only so many days to live, while the games themselves have sought to create their own new genre and style. Across 2010 and 2011, two Rainblood games were released, with only the first making it to the West via a fan translation apparently approved by the developer, S-Game CEO Qiwei âSoulframeâ Liang, and being sold on fan sites. These titles are turn-based RPGs set in the same world as Phantom Blade , and seem to share almost no gameplay DNA with the upcoming triple-A game. In 2013, they were followed up by Rain Blood Chronicles: Mirage (yes, Rain Blood is two words now), a Unity-powered hack-and-slash 2D brawler which did actually make its way to Steam and consolesâthough the Xbox and PlayStation versions now seem to be delisted. All three of these games are noticeably unpolished, but make up for it with their striking, dark and twisted interpretation of the Ming Dynasty. Following Mirage , S-game published three China-exclusive mobile games. Then in May 2023, Phantom Blade Zero , a big-budget 3D action game, was announced, followed by the release of Phantom Blade: Executioners in November, a 2D beat âem up which came out on PS4, PS5, and mobile, though again the console ports seem to have been pulled. Both of these games share commonalities with Soulframeâs earlier releases, most notably a recurring motif of crimson blades wielded by the protagonist that stand out in the often grim and grey world; however, these games feel noticeably small compared to a triple-A game featuring Donnie Yen. All this leads to the question: Where did the exponential increase in fidelity and scope come from? The short answer, via a machine-translated article in Chinese publication ChuApp , seems to be âTencent.â Following the completion of rounds of funding from NetEase and the Chinese venture capital firm ZhenFund, Soulframe disclosed in an open letter in 2021 that Lingyou Fangâor, as it’s called in the West, S-Gameâârecently completed a round of financing on the scale of hundreds of millions of dollarsâ from the Chinese mega-corp for two large-scale action RPGs over the next five years. While the second of these projects, âStellar Saga,â is still MIA, the other is the continuation of Soulframeâs long-running series. Which all brings us to now, and my four-ish hours with Phantom Blade Zero . Something that I have noted in my previous time with this game is that while it bears some surface-level similarities to the assortment of Chinese-developed Souls -inspired games like Black Myth: Wukong and Wuchang: Fallen Feathers , in practice it plays closer to a hybrid of Sekiro and Devil May Cry, fusing elements of the formerâs fast, stagger-focused combat with the latterâs stylish action-game sensibilities. This design ethos is best showcased in how the stamina bar functions. Oftentimes in games that seek to offer a faster version of a typical Souls -like combat system, I find myself frustrated by the fact that I can combo chains of attacks with flashy animations, but because each swing of the sword eats away at my stamina bar, I often find myself incapable of extricating myself from enemies’ ripostes. Phantom Blade addresses this, as your stamina doesnât go down when attacking or successfully blocking, only when dodging or attempting to block certain color-coded attacks. Moreover, your light attacks do not take animation priority over all other inputs, meaning that if you start a swing only to realize a boss will strike you first, you can quickly hit block mid-attack to protect yourself. This focus on offensive combat over a muddled mix of Souls -ish turtling, stamina regen, and protracted combos instantly makes Phantom Blade both more intuitive than some of its closest contemporaries and more compelling and cohesive. The design seems to be less focused on finding ways to force wuxia into a Souls game and more focused on creating a combat system purpose-built to highlight both the flow and speed of wuxia media, resulting in something I find infinitely more interesting and rewarding. Phantom Blade âs free-flowing combat focuses on 30 primary weapons, each with its own unique moveset and properties, and 25 secondary weapons, some of which, like axes, grant you heavy charge attacks while others, like mini-cannons, are slow-firing ranged weapons. You can equip two primary weapons at a time, keeping one off-hand and ready to go; however, while you can simply swap to your other primary by hitting the D-pad, you can also work it into a combo with the left trigger. This system is interesting because the combo-weapon-change both deal a lot of damage and stagger to enemies but is also on a cooldown, meaning that if you get into a good flow dealing with a boss with a longsword, comboing away from it to your dual-blades might not actually be the best move. While the combat of Phantom Blade Zero feels distinctly un-Soulslike, the same cannot be said for the world. The press release for the game highlights that Phantom Blade âs interconnected world is âinspired by Soulslike map design.â In lieu of a traditional, highly detailed video game map, youâre instead provided with hand-painted, ink washâstyle charts of the area painted on Xuan paper and scanned into the game. This more abstract map is paire

sources.title: Zenless Zone Zero version 3.3 update ‘Journey to the Sky’ launches October 21
sources.text: The version 3.3 update for Zenless Zone Zero , dubbed “Journey to the Sky,” will launch on October 21, developer miHoYo announced. Here is an overview of the update, via miHoYo: S-Rank Anomaly Agent Phoenix will make her debut in the first half, followed by S-Rank Attack Agent Severian in the second half. The new version also introduces brand-new mech combat gameplay, allowing Proxies to pilot combat mechs to infiltrate enemy bases in disguise and experience a fresh combat style combining melee and ranged action. In Version 3.3’s main story, the conflict over the sky island of Roscaelifer reaches a new peak: traffic to the entire island of Booastrum is locked down, and the only way to get back in is through the occupied skyport—Quietude Isle. Forced to travel together, can Judge Phoenix and Commissioner Severian put their differences aside and truly join forces? The Proxy will also touch down on the island alongside Lindverne, inching ever closer to the truth behind the three Sunbringers and the Karma Cores within them. S-Rank Fire Anomaly Agent Phoenix is Krampus Compliance Authority’s second-in-command when it comes to combat. Thanks to her unique physique, she is extremely hard to bring down—the fiercer her opponents resist, the more her fighting spirit is fired up. Her Core Skill, Nirvana, can sear enemies afflicted by an Anomaly, allowing subsequent Anomaly DMG dealt to them to trigger a critical hit. Even if she suffers a fatal strike, Phoenix won’t be put out of commission. Instead, she can trigger Rebirth to revive on the spot with full health and jump right back into the fray. Phoenix will make her debut in the first half alongside the S-Rank W-Engine, Plume of Rebirth. Dropping in for the second half is S-Rank Wind Attack Agent Severian, a senior commissioner at New Eridu Public Security who won’t hesitate to use necessary violence to uphold true order. His Core Skill, Endless Breeze, allows him to automatically dodge an incoming attack and ride the momentum to launch a counterattack. After a successful dodge or hitting enemies with a specific skill, he can build up Energy to unleash even more powerful continuous slashes. He will debut alongside the S-Rank W-Engine, Incarcerating Grip. As for reruns, S-Rank Agent Velina and the W-Engine Joyau Dore will be making a comeback in the first half, while Norma and the W-Engine Chief Sidekick will return in the second half. In terms of outfits, you can purchase Phoenix’s two brand-new outfits as a bundle at a limited-time 30% discount. Severian’s everyday uniform, Solemnly Impeccable, will also hit the store when his Signal Search channel becomes available in the second half of the version. The new update also brings fresh avatars, dynamic wallpapers, and trust events for both Agents. Plus, the all-new sidebar theme and pendant dropping in Version 3.3 can be claimed through the in-game New Eridu City Fund. As for version events, businesses in Lumina Square are teaming up to host the “Night of Supernatural Tricks” event, and the HIA Club is rolling out a brand-new VR game, “Spooky Funhouse Tales”. Proxies can drive various styles of Trickmobiles and scare away uninvited funhouse guests, obtaining rewards such as an Angels of Delusion outfit, a brand-new A-Rank W-Engine, and fresh Proxy accessories. Additionally, in the “Cyber Miracle Healer, on Duty!” event, Proxies will need to flex their cyber miracle healer skills once more to fix Bangboo that have gone haywire after accidentally eating “toxic” chips. In the “Trails of the Hobbling Crow” event, Proxies have to track down the culprit who attacked Crowe, and in “Repair! Drifting Art,” they must piece together painting fragments lost at sea. Of course, the familiar Area Patrol and Combat Simulation double-drop events will also make their return. In terms of gameplay, Version 3.3’s Main Story will deliver a brand-new mech combat experience. In the story, Lindverne will use her Karma Core power, “Genesis Reconstruction,” to create multiple High Ambitions Corp. combat mechs, which Proxies can then pilot to engage in combat with enemies. The mechs feature both melee and ranged attack modes that can be freely swapped. Furthermore, after using an EX Special Attack or dodging enemy attacks, you can unleash an even more powerful laser attack. Using the environment to shoot explosives or throwing heavy punches to launch heavy objects will make combat and puzzle-solving much smoother. This gameplay will continue to be available in future versions. Additionally, the permanent Hollow exploration, combat, and extraction mode, Enigma of the Labyrinth, is getting a seasonal update titled Spooky Trial. A Devilboo instructor who calls himself Master Devil will issue a three-round progressive challenge to Proxies. The Candle Cores obtained during the trials can be sold for the best price by comparing offers across shops owned by your friends or Outpost group members. Version 3.3 also introduces a couple of system experience optimizations: Fairy will begin providing a team recommendation function, which recommends team lineups, strategies, and basic operational briefs tailored to a Proxy’s existing roster. The team lineups can also be applied to a preset config with a single click. Also, exclusive tutorial videos will be included for some Agents to help Proxies master them faster. During the Squad Configuration phase of certain permanent combat modes, the system will offer challenge tips based on the number of deployed squad members, enhancement progress, and team synergy. Proxies can also jump straight to the relevant guide with a single click. Additionally, Inter-Knot Reputation promotion benefits are displayed more intuitively, and the system will provide guidance or promotion reminders based on your Inter-Knot level and promotion progress.
